نشتري (form VIII)
# نَشْتَرِي (naštarī) /naʃ.ta.riː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
# نَشْتَرِيَ (naštariya) /naʃ.ta.ri.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
